climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: Arizona's first AVA, in the southeast by the Mexican border, south of Tucson. It covers about 208,000 acres. The Babacomari Ranch worked with the University of Arizona to test Vitis vinifera and winemaking here.
